references.finding: Stock JavaScript kill validates pid, invokes process._kill for signal0 and wraps nonzero result as ErrnoException with syscall kill. The dynamic _kill reference means a bound kill function is not runtime proof of an uninterposed binding.
Stock Kill native binding converts arguments and calls uv_kill. This inspected function has no Node Permission Model branch.
Stock Unix uv_kill delegates to kill and returns translated errno. The special MVS path does not establish Darwin behavior.
Permission Model is enabled by a CLI flag and documented denials use ERR_ACCESS_DENIED. This does not prove historical model state or rule out an external host filter.
Non-Windows detached:true specifies new process group/session leadership. This is API/source semantics, not an independent historical PGID measurement.
